neighbours.label: the auxiliary or link word after a subject that is about to be launched or started (project, investigation, war, campaign), predicting 'launched/undertaken/initiated'
fire: After the floods, a major rebuilding programme was started across the region.
Following the complaints, an inquiry was opened into the hospital's finances.
When the border was crossed, a counter-offensive was ordered by the general.
In 2015, a nationwide vaccination campaign was launched in rural districts.
After the leak, criminal proceedings were initiated against two officials.
Once funding arrived, an ambitious excavation was begun at the hillfort.
After the attack, a massive manhunt was mounted across three counties.
In response to the strike, emergency talks were convened by the minister.
quiet: After the floods, a large bowl of soup was served to every volunteer.
Following the complaints, the hospital car park was painted a lighter grey.
When the border was crossed, the scenery was green and very quiet.
In 2015, a small grey kitten was found in a box in rural districts.
After the leak, the kitchen floor was wet and slippery for hours.
Once funding arrived, the old office was cleaner and much brighter.
After the attack, the weather was cold and windy across three counties.
In response to the strike, the trains were almost empty all morning.

predictions: 6/8 fire; auxiliaries after subjects that are served, eaten or described stay under 0.3
notes: Probe: 'a large project was [undertaken]' 0.890, 'Investigations were [launched]' 0.571, 'a holy war is [declared]' 0.467; 'a large dinner was' 0.106, 'The survey was completed' 0.154, 'The investigations were slow' 0.250 (subject alone sets up the prediction). Logit effect promotes ' launch', ' initiate'.
